issues.title: fix: install script rejects a relative prefix
issues.body:
`scripts/install.sh` accepts a relative `--prefix` and installs outside the tree.

## Target files
- `scripts/install.sh`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Add a unit test that asserts a relative prefix is rejected
- [ ] An absolute prefix still installs into that directory
